description:
Run every available pretrained backbone on YOUR data and see which wins —
a ranked bar chart with CI whiskers, params, and wall time per backbone.
Backbones that can't process your data (window size, channel count) are
noted, not silently skipped. Each backbone embeds your
trials frozen (the exact foundation_features preprocessing), a LDA is
cross-validated on the embeddings, and meta.results carries the
per-backbone accuracy, CI, embed dim, params, and time — pick the
foundation_features backbone by measurement, not vibes.

mode.description: Pack split to load: training | evaluation | all (source=dataset).

path.description: Upload path (source=upload) or absolute local path (source=local).

source.description:
"dataset" (MOABB pack), "upload" (path from data.upload), or
"local" (absolute path, local backend only).
